Regional Development Agency Assistance Program

The Regional Development Agency Assistance Program (RDAAP) is established as a system of grants to Special Purpose Governmental Entities, as defined by KRS 65A.010(9) and in KRS 96.895, and in partnership with county governments.

Eligibility Criteria

The Regional Development Agency Assistance Program (RDAAP) provides funding for eligible projects that support economic and community development within Kentucky's coal-impacted regions. Applicants must meet program requirements and demonstrate that the proposed project aligns with the goals and objectives of the program.

Required Documentation

Must submit completed application form, Authorizing Resolution and SPGE Resolution, Legislative Concurrence Letter, and additional supporting documentation if requested by DLG.

Award Details

Grants obtained under this program are for the following activities, per KRS 96.905:

  • Economic Development and Job Creation activities;

  • Acquiring federal, state, or private matching funds to the extent possible; and

  • Debt service for approved projects.​

Application Process

  • Complete the RDAAP application form.

  • Prepare a project scope and budget describing the proposed project and anticipated outcomes.

  • Obtain an authorizing Fiscal Court resolution and required legislative concurrence letters.

  • Submit the completed application package and supporting documentation to DLG.

  • DLG will review the application for completeness, eligibility, and compliance prior to award consideration.
